race.comment: BAKERSBEND (1) doesn't win out of turn, scoring just once from 12 starts, but hasn't seen many races of this quality. Doesn't need to improve much to be right in the finish and should get every chance from the inside alley. SAVETHEBESTTILLAST (5) boasts a level of consistency not many others here have put together and was only beaten half a length last start. Repeat of that has him right in the mix. CRACKERJACK HUTCH (9) ran up to a nice trial with a fine first-up effort but just might need a bit of luck here from the wide gate. PRESTIGE GEOFFREY (3) finished sixth over 2100m at Stony Creek at his most recent appearance on March 8. Hasn't placed in two fresh runs to date but finds the right race to improve on that. TASSADAR (4) will appreciate the longer journey after finishing a solid fourth when resuming last start over 1200m at this track.
